breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the specified Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions. It discarded the incorrect periodic condition and proceeded only with the Dirichlet conditions (u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0), which is the correct resolution as shown in the ground truth.
